entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 428 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 47.8 kDa and theoretical pI 6.14.
Has Pfam Aminotran_5 domain at residues 48–256 and KYNU_C domain at residues 328–418.
Shows 67–69% identity and about 96% query coverage to curated bacterial kynureninases, with E-values below 3×10^-202.
Most likely a PLP-dependent kynureninase, but exact substrate specificity remains homology-based until experimentally tested.

entities.name: B2FL97 kynureninase
observations: Cleaves L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine, and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine.
Uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate and is annotated as a homodimer.
Annotated to the cytoplasm, L-tryptophan catabolism, L-kynurenine degradation, NAD+ biosynthesis, and quinolinate biosynthesis.

entities.name: PLP cofactor
observations: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate is the cofactor for the reference kynureninase reaction; the reference enzyme contains a PLP-linked lysine.

entities.name: Kynurenine cleavage
observations: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H+; Rhea RHEA:16813.

entities.name: Kynurenine metabolism
observations: Likely participates in bacterial L-kynurenine degradation and can contribute to quinolinate/NAD+ biosynthesis by converting kynurenine-pathway intermediates.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Cytoplasmic localization is inferred from reviewed bacterial kynureninase homolog annotations; the query sequence has no evident signal peptide or transmembrane segment in the reported analysis.
